name: 37013 · Antioch, TN
findings: ZIP 37013 (Antioch) has 192 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37013 (Antioch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37013 (Antioch) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
